source: Original layered battle cues, with oscillator and noise synthesis as the loading fallback.
mixer: The battle score follows Music volume. Battle cues use sfxBus and follow SFX volume.

sampleBank.events: Card selection, skill preparation, release, hit, parry, dash, boss warnings and impacts

music.scope: Bakunawa card battle, real-time encounter and practice

cues.design: Low sawtooth descent and low-passed swell
Short rising tension cue before impact
Water crash and bass transient, with a bright burst snap, tail swish, vortex rise, or lower abyss impact by attack type.
Sub-bass swell, ascending celestial tones, and a bright release transient
Short rising release; spell-specific casting cues distinguish Arcane Pulse, Tidal Arc, Moon Cut, and Charged Starburst
Low cinematic swell followed by ascending celestial tones and a restrained sparkle
Deep impact hit, layered magic chime, and filtered crash synchronized to the beam hit
Low submerged rumble with a soft water wash during Bakunawa's final line

coverage: Boss attacks have wind-up and impact cues; player spells have distinct synthesized cast and release cues; the boss-defeat cinematic has charge, beam impact and sinking cues. Dock creak, lantern fire, wind and jaw do not have dedicated sounds. No voice recordings are included; cinematic dialogue is displayed as timed subtitles.
